_comment: Generated by scripts/export_mpred_demo.py from the test split of the nuScenes CAN bus expansion (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0); do not edit by hand.

labels.stale: no compensation: the newest pose, no prediction
labels.dynamic: linear dynamic single track, inputs held
labels.ekf: EKF-CTRA (pose + wheel speed + IMU yaw rate + accel)
labels.mlp: MLP on the raw history window

predictor_meta.objective: mean over 100/200/300/500 ms of (mean position error + mean |20 m overlay offset|), validation split, metres

scenes.label: Sharp right turn, 6 m/s
scenes.rule: the start point with the largest yaw-rate change over the next 0.5 s at >= 6 m/s wheel speed (the rule of the report's scene trace)

scenes.label: Turning in and out, 8 m/s
scenes.rule: most start points labelled 'yaw-rate change (turn in / out)'

scenes.label: Fastest scene, 11 m/s
scenes.rule: highest mean wheel speed over the start points

scenes.label: Low speed, 2 m/s
scenes.rule: most start points labelled 'low speed (< 5 m/s)'

scenes.label: Hardest for CTRV, 7 m/s
scenes.rule: largest scene mean |20 m overlay offset| of CTRV at 200 ms

scenes.label: Least EKF + MLP gain, 10 m/s
scenes.rule: largest scene mean |20 m overlay offset| of EKF + MLP minus CTRV at 200 ms (the scene where the hybrid helps least)

scenes.label: Most noise-sensitive (EKF + MLP), 2 m/s
scenes.rule: largest growth of the EKF + MLP scene mean |20 m overlay offset| at 200 ms from noise level 0 to 1
